what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 2006 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the five-year outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 2006 annual town report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (PDF page 67) and a repayment schedule (pages 68-69) with no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: its Textract text was searched for debt limit, outstanding and indebtedness, and returned only the index entry (p3) and the headings of pages 67-69. — closes: the Town's FY2006 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.

what: What was the Town's non-union salary schedule (grade by step) and classification plan in 2006?
why: `salary-schedule` and the 2010 edition's classification plan read Schedule A from the Salary Administration Plan article. The 2006 annual town report prints no Schedule A: its Textract text was searched for salary schedule, schedule a, point value, classification and salary administration, and returned only the appropriation-schedule heading `SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS` (pp50-55) and three warrant articles funding a merit increase under the Salary Administration Plan (pp90, 108, 111) without its rates. — closes: the Salary Administration Plan, Schedule A, in force for FY2007, from the Town Clerk or the Human Resources office.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test, seal or condemn in 2006, and for what fees?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Inspector of Weights & Measures' device counts and fees from the 2010 edition. The 2006 annual town report prints no Sealer's report: its Textract text was searched for weights, sealer and sealed, and returned only the appointment (p8), the appropriation line (p51), the omnibus line (p91) and the payroll department (p119); the receipts page (p48) prints SEALING FEES $3,070.00 as one account. — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 2006 annual report to the Division of Standards.

what: Are the gross wages in the 2006 payroll report calendar-year 2006 or fiscal-year 2006 earnings?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds CALENDAR 2010 wages from the 2010 edition and FISCAL-year wages from FY2011 onward. The 2006 PAYROLL REPORT (PDF pages 112-121) prints no year and no basis on any page; its Textract text was searched for payroll, calendar and fiscal around those pages and returned only the page headings. So its 566 rows cannot be compared with either series. — closes: the Treasurer's payroll report for 2006 as run, or the W-2 totals for calendar 2006.
